鞋底和地面的摩擦帮助我们走路而不打滑。摩擦不是只会“捣乱”。搓一搓手会变暖，也能: Friction between shoes and the ground helps us walk without slipping. It is useful too. Rubbing your hands warms them, giving a clue that motion energy can become thermal energy.

本页模拟水平地面上的滑动木块，松手后不再施力。用近似动摩擦模型 F = μmg，: These blocks slide on level ground with no continued push. The approximate kinetic-friction model F = μmg gives deceleration μg and stopping distance d = v₀²/(2μg). Blocks do not reverse after stopping. The three illustrative coefficients are 0.12, 0.28 and 0.50, not measured material data. Real friction depends on both materials, surface condition and contact; visible roughness alone does not determine it.
这里使用没有轮子的滑动玩具，不能把结果直接当成小汽车的滚动距离。省略空气阻力、表: The toys slide without wheels, so these results do not directly describe rolling toy cars. Air resistance, surface deformation and starting static friction are omitted. Time is in seconds and all lanes use the same visual scale. Material names identify these illustrative scenarios; real wood, cloth and sandpaper need not always rank this way.
